title: pavonia fonsecana
intro: Pavonia fonsecana, commonly known as the Mexican Rose Mallow, is a flowering plant species in the family Malvaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues.
